arxiv-2109-05260.title: The A A -Möbius function of a finite group
arxiv-2109-05260.creator: Francesca Dalla Volta, Andrea Lucchini
arxiv-2109-05260.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Francesca Dalla Volta, Andrea Lucchini. The Möbius function of the subgroup lettice of a finite group G G has been introduced by Hall and applied to investigate several different questions. We propose the following generalization. Let A A be a subgroup of the automorphism group Aut ⁡ ( G ) \aut(G) of a finite group G G and denote by 𝒞 A ​ ( G ) \mathcal{C}_{A}(G) the set of A A -conjugacy classes of subgroups of G .

arxiv-2409-15736.title: SoMaSLAM: 2D Graph SLAM for Sparse Range Sensing with Soft Manhattan World Constraints
arxiv-2409-15736.creator: Jeahn Han, Zichao Hu, Seonmo Yang, Minji Kim, Pyojin Kim
arxiv-2409-15736.description: Abstract We propose a graph SLAM algorithm for sparse range sensing that incorporates a soft Manhattan world utilizing landmark-landmark constraints. Sparse range sensing is necessary for tiny robots that do not have the luxury of using heavy and expensive sensors.

arxiv-2411-10105.title: Parametric Autoresonance with Time-Delayed Control
arxiv-2411-10105.creator: Somnath Roy, Mattia Coccolo, Miguel A.F. Sanjuán
arxiv-2411-10105.description: Abstract We investigate how a constant time delay influences a parametric autoresonant system. This is a nonlinear system driven by a parametrically chirped force with a negative delay-feedback that maintains adiabatic phase locking with the driving frequency. This phase locking results in a continuous amplitude growth, regardless of parameter changes.

arxiv-2412-13330.title: Simulating imperfect quantum optical circuits using unsymmetrized bases
arxiv-2412-13330.creator: John Steinmetz, Maike Ostmann, Alex Neville, Brendan Pankovich, Adel Sohbi
arxiv-2412-13330.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by John Steinmetz, Maike Ostmann, Alex Neville, Brendan Pankovich, Adel Sohbi. Fault-tolerant photonic quantum computing requires the generation of large entangled resource states. The required size of these states makes it challenging to simulate the effects of errors such as loss and partial distinguishability. For an interferometer with N N partially distinguishable input photons and M M spatial modes, the Fock basis can have up to ( N + N ​ M − 1 N ) {N+NM-1\choose N} elements.

arxiv-2501-12563.title: Some Remarks on Isoparametric Functions in Closed 4-Manifolds
arxiv-2501-12563.creator: Minghao Li
arxiv-2501-12563.description: Abstract . We study transnormal and isoparametric functions on closed Riemannian 4-manifolds and establish fundamental restrictions on their topology and geometry. In particular, we show that such manifolds cannot be endowed with negatively curved metrics, contrasting with known results in the compact simply connected case. Moreover, in certain cases, we provide a description of their fundamental groups.

arxiv-2503-19230.title: Random skeletons in high-dimensional lattice trees
arxiv-2503-19230.creator: Manuel Cabezas, Alexander Fribergh, Mark Holmes, Edwin Perkins
arxiv-2503-19230.description: Abstract We study the behaviour of the rescaled minimal subtree containing the origin and K K random vertices selected from a random critical (sufficiently spread-out, and in dimensions d > 8 d>8 ) lattice tree conditioned to survive until time n ​ s ns , in the limit as n n goes to infinity.

arxiv-2507-00306.title: Origin-destination travel demand estimation: An approach that scales worldwide, and its application to five metropolitan highway networks Journal: Transportation Research Part B
arxiv-2507-00306.creator: Chao Zhang, Neha Arora, Christopher Bian, Yechen Li, Willa Ng, Andrew Tomkins, Bin Yan, Janny Zhang, Carolina Osorio
arxiv-2507-00306.description: Abstract Estimating Origin-Destination (OD) travel demand is vital for effective urban planning and traffic management. Developing universally applicable OD estimation methodologies is significantly challenged by the pervasive scarcity of high-fidelity traffic data and the difficulty in obtaining city-specific prior OD estimates (or seed ODs), which are often prerequisite for traditional approaches.

arxiv-2507-08005.title: Unraveling the Potential of Diffusion Models in Small Molecule Generation
arxiv-2507-08005.creator: Peining Zhang, Daniel Baker, Minghu Song, Jinbo Bi
arxiv-2507-08005.description: Abstract Generative AI presents chemists with novel ideas for drug design and facilitates the exploration of vast chemical spaces. Diffusion models (DMs), an emerging tool, have recently attracted great attention in drug R&D. This paper comprehensively reviews the latest advancements and applications of DMs in molecular generation. It begins by introducing the theoretical principles of DMs.

pmc-10492822.title: Genome-wide DNA methylation patterns in bumble bee (Bombus vosnesenskii) populations from spatial-environmental range extremes
pmc-10492822.creator: Sarthok Rasique Rahman, Jeffrey D Lozier
pmc-10492822.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Unraveling molecular mechanisms of adaptation to complex environments is crucial to understanding tolerance of abiotic pressures and responses to climatic change. Epigenetic variation is increasingly recognized as a mechanism that can facilitate rapid responses to changing environmental cues. To investigate variation in genetic and epigenetic diversity at spatial and thermal extremes, we use whole genome and methylome sequencing to generate a high-resolution map of DNA methylation in the bumble bee Bombus vosnesenskii.

pmc-10532320.title: Differential Sensitivity of Germline and Somatic BRCA Variants to PARP Inhibitor in High-Grade Serous Ovarian Cancer
pmc-10532320.creator: Julie A. Vendrell, Iulian O. Ban, Isabelle Solassol, Patricia Audran, Simon Cabello-Aguilar, Delphine Topart, Clothilde Lindet-Bourgeois, Pierre-Emmanuel Colombo, Eric Legouffe, Véronique D’Hondt, Michel Fabbro, Jérôme Solassol
pmc-10532320.description: Purpose: The introduction of PARP inhibitors (PARPis) as a treatment option for patients with high-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC) modified the approach of BRCA testing worldwide. In this study, we aim to evaluate the impact of BRCA1 and BRCA2 variants on treatment response and survival outcomes in patients diagnosed in our institution.

pmc-11511375.title: An Ethnobotanical Study in Kırşehir (Türkiye)
pmc-11511375.creator: Gizem Emre, İsmail Şenkardeş, Kaan İşcan, Oltan Evcimen, İlknur Yılmaz, Osman Tugay
pmc-11511375.description: A comprehensive ethnobotanical study was carried out in the province of Kırsehir, in the Central Anatolia region. The result of that study is this publication containing information about the main traditional folk medicine, wild food plants, and other plant uses in the area. Our goal was to collect, identify, and provide information about plants traditionally used by the local population.

pmc-12497346.title: NLRP3 inflammasome and hearing loss: from mechanisms to therapies
pmc-12497346.creator: Silvia Murillo-Cuesta, Elena Seoane, Blanca Cervantes, Jose Manuel Zubeldia, Isabel Varela-Nieto
pmc-12497346.description: The NLRP3 inflammasome, a key component of the innate immune system, has emerged as a central mediator of inflammation-driven sensorineural hearing loss (SNHL). This review synthesizes current evidence on its involvement across a wide spectrum of auditory pathologies, including genetic syndromes such as CAPS and autosomal dominant deafness (DFNA) 34, as well as noise-induced, age-related, drug-induced, and viral hearing loss.

pmc-13380430.title: Awake cortex stabilizes traveling waves for global and reliable information routing
pmc-13380430.creator: Kaio Misawa, Koji Chinen, Akira Kawabata, Taro Kaiju, Takafumi Suzuki, Yutaka Komura
pmc-13380430.description: SummaryHow does the brain organize neural information for perception during wakefulness, yet lose such organization under anesthesia? Theories on consciousness hypothesize that perceptual experience arises from global communication across the cerebral cortex. However, the neural substrate that mediates information transfer between cortical regions remains uncertain.
